name: docstring_sphinx_guidelines
title: Waterloo Docstring Guidelines for Sphinx
description: Best practices for writing Sphinx-compatible Waterloo docstrings

arguments.name: context
arguments.description: Optional context about what you're documenting

messages.content: I'm writing a Waterloo docstring that will be processed by Sphinx. $context

When generating Waterloo docstrings for code processed by Sphinx:

Avoid pipe-expressions (|...|) except for:
- Normativity Keywords: |Must|, |Should|, |May|, etc.
- Defined markup roles (as specified in waterloo.markup)

Do not use pipes for arbitrary symbols (|messages|, |parse|, |Element|, etc.) to prevent Sphinx xref errors when extracting docstrings.

This ensures correct rendering in both Sphinx documentation and Waterloo tools.
